claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Butoconazole is an imidazole antifungal that inhibits fungal sterol 14-alpha-demethylase; at 2.5 uM in a 5-day pooled human cancer cell line viability screen it is expected to be largely inactive because its target (fungal CYP51/ergosterol biosynthesis) is not required by human cancer cells, and no human off-target cytotoxicity is expected at this concentration.
